meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按时间段汇总会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需整理团队会议记录并定期产出摘要
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes into a structured report for a time range
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into reports

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求整理会议纪要时，Claude 会按指定时间范围查询 Lark 会议，抓取纪要文档与逐字稿链接，输出结构化报告（单日概览或多日周报），也可按需生成云文档。
howto.when: 当你提到整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾某段时间的会议内容时触发；默认查询过去 7 天，且仅支持 user 身份。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要，生成一份周报
say.note: 默认按过去 7 天汇总

say.text: 把上周的会议纪要汇总生成一个云文档
say.note: 汇总后调用文档创建命令生成

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude queries your Lark meetings in a given time range, collects meeting notes and transcript links, and outputs a structured report (single-day overview or multi-day weekly digest). It can also create or append a Lark doc when you ask.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to organize meeting notes, generate a meeting weekly report, or review meetings from a period. Defaults to the past 7 days, and only the user identity is supported.

say_en.text: Summarize this week's meeting notes into a weekly report
Show me which meetings I had today
Compile last week's meeting notes into a Lark doc
